name: Blitz Trainer
description: Blitzkrieg practice that tracks itself and moves your spawn for you

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub. Include the newest file from geode/logs.

stage-style.name: Default stage style
stage-style.description: Used when a profile is created automatically. <cy>Classic</c> is Rudder's original method (every window of 1, 2, 3 ... sections). <cy>Lite</c> uses windows of 1, 2, 4, 8 ... sections for long levels.

required-passes.name: Passes per range
required-passes.description: How many times you need to beat a range before it counts as done. 2 or 3 builds real consistency.

require-consecutive.name: Passes must be in a row
require-consecutive.description: A failed attempt on a range resets its pass streak.

credit-all-passed.name: Long runs credit shorter ranges
credit-all-passed.description: A run that covers several unfinished ranges of the current stage gives each of them a pass, not just the one you aimed for.

auto-route.name: Auto-move spawn
auto-route.description: When the range you're on is finished, your next respawn moves to the next unfinished range. No more switching start positions by hand.

route-order.name: Route order
route-order.description: Which unfinished range auto-move and <cy>Go to target</c> pick next. <cy>In order</c> goes left to right, <cy>Weakest first</c> picks the range with the lowest pass rate, <cy>Random</c> mixes it up.

auto-create-profile.name: Auto-create profiles
auto-create-profile.description: Start tracking as soon as you open a level that has start positions.

track-practice.name: Track practice mode
track-practice.description: Count practice-mode attempts that start from a start position. Attempts from practice checkpoints are never counted.

record-untracked-deaths.name: Heatmap includes all deaths
record-untracked-deaths.description: Add deaths from spawns that aren't training starts (e.g. practice checkpoints) to the death heatmap.

daily-goal.name: Daily pass goal
daily-goal.description: How many passes to aim for each day. Shown in the HUD, with a streak for days in a row you hit it. 0 turns it off.

detect-noclip.name: Ignore noclip runs
detect-noclip.description: Don't count attempts where you touched a hazard and survived.

detect-speedhack.name: Ignore speedhacked runs
detect-speedhack.description: Don't count attempts where game speed didn't match real time (lag spikes are ignored).

show-hud.name: Show in-level HUD
show-hud.description: Shows the current stage, your target range, passes and a mini map of start positions.

show-notifications.name: Notifications
show-notifications.description: Pop-ups for passes, finished ranges, finished stages and ignored runs.

play-sounds.name: Sounds
play-sounds.description: Play a sound on passes, finished ranges and finished stages (uses your SFX volume).

auto-backups.name: Daily backups
auto-backups.description: Once a day, save a copy of a level's progress the first time you open it. Restore one from <cy>Blitz Trainer > Manage</c>.

backups-keep.name: Backups to keep
backups-keep.description: Days of backups kept per level. Older ones are deleted.
